Save a pdmS7 figure at a standard size

Source: R/visuals.R
pdm_save.Rd

Writes a figure to PNG, PDF or SVG, chosen by the file's extension, at one of the standard sizes:

Usage

pdm_save(
  plot,
  file,
  preset = "screen",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  dpi = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

What to draw.

file

Output path ending in .png, .pdf or .svg.

preset

One of the presets above.

width, height

Size in inches, overriding the preset.

dpi

Resolution for PNG, overriding the preset.

...

Passed to plot() when plot is an object, such as type = "duration".

Value

file, invisibly.

Details

PresetSize (inches)ResolutionTextUse
screen8 x 4.5110 dpi11 ptscreens, articles, the app
report6.3 x 3.6300 dpi10 ptfull width of an A4 report
report_half3.1 x 2.6300 dpi8 pthalf width of an A4 report
slide10 x 5.6200 dpi14 pt16:9 slides
journal_single3.35 x 2.6600 dpi8 ptone journal column
journal_double6.9 x 3.6600 dpi9 pttwo journal columns

plot may be a ggplot (from autoplot()), any object with a plot() method, such as a pdm_series(), or a function of no arguments that draws in base graphics.

See also

pdm_colours(), theme_pdm()

Examples

s <- pdm_series(simulated = sin(1:200 / 10) + 2, observed = sin(1:200 / 10 + 0.2) + 2)
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
pdm_save(s, f, preset = "report")
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE
